_doc: The voice module's own Python (2026-10-07, the User: the voice envs never use the system Python; Ubuntu ships 3.14 only and every lock in this folder is for 3.12). crissa_voice/pyenv.py reads this file; a copy at <crissa home>/voice-python.json wins key by key. Each engine's env (<crissa home>/<engine>/env) is made by micromamba from conda-forge with the pinned Python and pip, then the engine's hash lock goes in with pip --require-hashes. One env per engine: the locks disagree (torch 2.6 for speech-in and Kokoro, 2.11 for Turbo, 2.14.1 for Pocket; numpy 1.26 against 2.x), so they cannot share one. micromamba's package cache (pkgs_dir) is shared, so the Python itself downloads once. Checked 2026-10-07: micromamba 2.9.0-0 is the latest release (2026-08-07), python 3.12.15 the latest 3.12 on conda-forge.
